faq.question: Does an ABN record confirm the trade licence for my job?
faq.answer: No. ABN Lookup verifies the business registration record, not the scope or current status of an individual trade licence. Request the documentation relevant to the proposed plumbing or electrical work privately before approval.

faq.question: Why does ABN Lookup show VIC when your office is in Perth?
faq.answer: ABN Lookup lists the registered company's main business location as VIC 3030. Our actual Perth office is at 140 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 6000. These are different records; the ABN entry does not verify the Perth office address or trade authorisation.

faq.question: How is Ellis Services Group set up in Perth?
faq.answer: Ellis Services Group is part of the Ellis Group, with an independent Perth office and a dedicated Perth repair team serving homeowners, property managers and real-estate agencies across Perth.

faq.question: Where can I verify the company details?
faq.answer: The Australian Business Register lists ELLIS SERVICES GROUP PTY LTD with ABN 96 645 821 745 and ACN 645 821 745. You can use the official ABR link above to view the current public record.

faq.question: Can I request licensing or insurance evidence?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask for the relevant current documentation before work is arranged, particularly where the scope includes regulated or specialist work.

faq.question: What repairs can I request?
faq.answer: You can request plumbing or electrical repairs, including blocked drains, leak concerns, hot-water problems, power faults, safety switches, lighting and power points. Describe the issue, property location and any access or approval details that are relevant.

faq.question: Do I need to know the cause of the problem before I contact you?
faq.answer: No. Describe what you can observe, such as where the issue appears, when it started and whether there are any immediate safety concerns.

faq.question: Can property managers and real-estate agencies contact Ellis Services Group?
faq.answer: Yes. Include the work-order reference, property address, occupant description, access contact and approval pathway where relevant.

headings.text: Blocked Drains Perth — Drain Clearing & Repairs
Blocked-drain clearing for kitchens, bathrooms and toilets
Slow sinks, showers and floor drains
Blocked toilets and wastewater backing up
Recurring blockage rather than a one-off restriction
How we scope drain clearing and further repairs
Clearing the obstruction versus repairing the drain
Blocked toilet or shower drain: tell us which outlets are affected
Blocked drains Perth: symptoms and service choices
Kitchen sink gurgling and slow drainage
Blocked-drain clearing costs and written quotes
Blocked Drains Perth — Drain Clearing & Repairs FAQs
Blocked drainage: clearing or fixture repair?

faq.question: Does a recurring blockage mean the drain must be replaced?
faq.answer: Not automatically. The condition and cause need assessment. Ask what the initial clearing covers and what evidence would justify further investigation or repair before approving excavation or replacement.

faq.question: Is a camera inspection included in every drain-clearing job?
faq.answer: Do not assume it is included. Ask whether further investigation is needed, what method is proposed and whether it is a separate scope and charge. Availability of a particular inspection method should be confirmed for the job.

faq.question: Why do drains keep blocking after they have been cleared?
faq.answer: An unresolved restriction or other underlying drainage problem can cause recurrence. Further investigation should establish the next scope. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Is a slow-flushing toilet always caused by a blocked drain?
faq.answer: No. Poor flushing can involve the cistern or toilet fixture as well as downstream drainage. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Why does my kitchen sink gurgle and drain slowly?
faq.answer: A drainage restriction can cause slow flow and gurgling, but the noise cannot identify its location or cause. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?
faq.answer: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: What details help with a blocked-drain request?
faq.answer: Tell us the affected fixture, whether water backs up elsewhere, when it began and whether the issue is getting worse.

faq.question: Should I keep using a blocked fixture?
faq.answer: Avoid using a fixture that is overflowing or causing water to return elsewhere. Do not use chemicals as a substitute for a repair assessment.

faq.question: Can a blocked toilet be related to a drain issue?
faq.answer: It can be useful to note whether other fixtures are slow, gurgling or backing up. Use the Toilet Repairs page for a toilet-specific concern and include all visible symptoms in the enquiry.

faq.question: Can you help with property-managed drainage issues?
faq.answer: Yes. Include the property reference, access details and approval contact.

faq.question: Does a blocked-drain quote include pipe replacement?
faq.answer: Clearing and pipe replacement are different scopes. We identify the proposed treatment and any separate investigation or repair in the written quote before additional work proceeds.

burst-pipe-repair-perth.html.title: Burst Pipe Repairs Perth | Ellis
burst-pipe-repair-perth.html.description: Burst pipe repairs in Perth for active pipe leaks and damaged water connections. Contact our local team for assessment, repair scope and a written quote.

headings.text: Repairing damaged water pipes and leaking connections
An exposed pipe or accessible joint
A leak behind a wall or below ground
Our burst-pipe assessment and repair approach
A defined repair scope before additional work
Burst pipe repairs Perth: symptoms and service choices
Signs of a leaking pipe inside a wall
Burst-pipe repair costs and access requirements
An active pipe leak and an uncertain source need different scopes

faq.question: Will the pipe-repair quote include wall or ceiling restoration?
faq.answer: Only when the written scope expressly includes it. Confirm pipe access, repair, testing and any separate restoration or other trade work rather than assuming that repairing the pipe restores every affected surface.

faq.question: Does an active leak guarantee an immediate call-out?
faq.answer: No. Call to explain the current condition and confirm availability and charges. Keep people clear of hazards; a normal booking request is not a substitute for emergency or utility action where needed.

faq.question: What are the signs of a burst or leaking pipe inside a wall?
faq.answer: Unexplained damp patches, stains or water may indicate a concealed leak, but inspection must distinguish plumbing from other sources. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?
faq.answer: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: What should I do first if a pipe bursts?
faq.answer: Put people and electrical safety first. If it is safe and familiar, isolate the water supply; otherwise keep clear and contact us with the details.

faq.question: When should I use the water leak page instead?
faq.answer: Use Water Leak Detection for an unexplained leak or damp area where there is no visible failed pipe. Use this page when water is actively escaping or a pipe or fitting has visibly failed.

faq.question: Do I need to know the pipe type?
faq.answer: No. A description of the location, water flow and affected area is more useful than a guess about the cause.

faq.question: Can a property manager make the booking?
faq.answer: Yes. Include access, occupant and work-order details in the enquiry.

faq.question: Will the quote include repairing the wall or floor?
faq.answer: The written scope states what access and reinstatement work is included. Plumbing repairs do not automatically include replacement finishes or separate building work. We clarify those items before proceeding.

            "text": "Unexplained damp patches, stains or water may indicate a concealed leak, but inspection must distinguish plumbing from other sources. Read the explanation."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Do I need to diagnose the problem first?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can I send photos?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What should I do first if a pipe bursts?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Put people and electrical safety first. If it is safe and familiar, isolate the water supply; otherwise keep clear and contact us with the details."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "When should I use the water leak page instead?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Use Water Leak Detection for an unexplained leak or damp area where there is no visible failed pipe. Use this page when water is actively escaping or a pipe or fitting has visibly failed."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Do I need to know the pipe type?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. A description of the location, water flow and affected area is more useful than a guess about the cause."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can a property manager make the booking?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. Include access, occupant and work-order details in the enquiry."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Will the quote include repairing the wall or floor?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "The written scope states what access and reinstatement work is included. Plumbing repairs do not automatically include replacement finishes or separate building work. We clarify those items before proceeding."
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

faq.question: Why does a ceiling fan hum but not turn?
faq.answer: A motor, control or other fan fault may be involved, but the sound alone does not identify the part. Stop using a fan behaving abnormally and arrange assessment rather than dismantling it or forcing the blades.

faq.question: Can a ceiling fan be repaired or should it be replaced?
faq.answer: That depends on the findings, parts availability and condition of the fan and controls. We explain the repair option and any proposed replacement before you approve the work.

faq.question: Can a fan go where a ceiling light is now?
faq.answer: It may be possible, but mounting support, clearance, wiring and controls must be checked. An existing lighting connection does not by itself establish a suitable fan installation.

faq.question: Can I supply my own ceiling fan?
faq.answer: Discuss the model before purchase. Confirm suitability, included controls, who supplies the product and any additional mounting or electrical work in the quote.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Why does a ceiling fan hum but not turn?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "A motor, control or other fan fault may be involved, but the sound alone does not identify the part. Stop using a fan behaving abnormally and arrange assessment rather than dismantling it or forcing the blades."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can a ceiling fan be repaired or should it be replaced?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "That depends on the findings, parts availability and condition of the fan and controls. We explain the repair option and any proposed replacement before you approve the work."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can a fan go where a ceiling light is now?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "It may be possible, but mounting support, clearance, wiring and controls must be checked. An existing lighting connection does not by itself establish a suitable fan installation."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can I supply my own ceiling fan?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Discuss the model before purchase. Confirm suitability, included controls, who supplies the product and any additional mounting or electrical work in the quote."
          }
        }
      ]

contact.html.title: Book Plumbing & Electrical Repairs Perth | Contact Ellis
contact.html.description: Contact Ellis in Perth for plumbing or electrical repairs and installations. Share the property location and issue to arrange an assessment and written quote.

headings.text: Prepare the request without extra investigation

faq.question: Do I need photos or an equipment model to send the form?
faq.answer: No. Start with the property address and a short description. Safely readable product details can help later. Photos are optional and may be emailed; do not dismantle equipment or approach water, wiring or wastewater to take them.

faq.question: Does sending this form confirm the appointment or price?
faq.answer: No. The team contacts you to agree the visit and assessment requirements. The written quote confirms the agreed work and price; submitting the form does not approve a repair or guarantee an arrival time.

faq.question: Should I enter your Perth office address in the repair form?
faq.answer: Enter the address of the property needing work, not our office address, unless the work is at that office. Our actual Perth office is at 140 St Georges Terrace, Perth WA 6000. Contact the team before visiting to confirm arrangements.

faq.question: What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry.

dishwasher-installation-perth.html.description: Dishwasher installation in Perth with agreed supply, old-unit removal and taking away. Check water, drainage and electrical requirements before quoting.

headings.text: Common situations and what to report
Replacing a dishwasher in the same space
A new location or water backing into the sink
Assessment, work plan and written quote

faq.question: Can you supply the dishwasher and take away the old one?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply, removal and taking away the old unit are available within the agreed installation package. Confirm the selected appliance, access and the included connection work in the written quote.

faq.question: Is a leaking dishwasher hose a plumbing issue or an appliance repair issue?
faq.answer: A leak at the supply valve, connection or external hose may involve plumbing; a leak inside the machine may require appliance repair. The source needs assessment. A wet cupboard alone does not establish which trade or component is responsible.

faq.question: Can you check the water and drain connections before installation?
faq.answer: Yes. We assess the existing connections and proposed product before agreeing the installation. Report leaking valves, slow drainage or previous overflows so those issues are included in the assessment.

faq.question: Does dishwasher installation include cabinet changes or a new power point?
faq.answer: Not automatically. New pipework, a new power point, circuit changes and cabinet alterations must be identified and included or excluded in the quote. The supplied dishwasher alone does not define that additional work.

      "url": "https://perthpipepower.com.au/dishwasher-installation-perth.html",
      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can you supply the dishwasher and take away the old one?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. Supply, removal and taking away the old unit are available within the agreed installation package. Confirm the selected appliance, access and the included connection work in the written quote."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is a leaking dishwasher hose a plumbing issue or an appliance repair issue?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "A leak at the supply valve, connection or external hose may involve plumbing; a leak inside the machine may require appliance repair. The source needs assessment. A wet cupboard alone does not establish which trade or component is responsible."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can you check the water and drain connections before installation?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. We assess the existing connections and proposed product before agreeing the installation. Report leaking valves, slow drainage or previous overflows so those issues are included in the assessment."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Does dishwasher installation include cabinet changes or a new power point?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Not automatically. New pipework, a new power point, circuit changes and cabinet alterations must be identified and included or excluded in the quote. The supplied dishwasher alone does not define that additional work."
          }
        }

faq.question: Should I mention entry or induction requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. Include relevant access requirements and the site contact when requesting the visit. Acceptance of the task, any induction and the work scope need to be confirmed, not inferred from the suburb.

faq.question: What helps with an Eastern Suburbs safety-switch repair request?
faq.answer: Include the property address, what changed, affected areas and any safe observations about the switch.

faq.question: Should a switchboard concern be listed with other repairs?
faq.answer: Yes, but identify the switchboard concern separately from plumbing or general maintenance items.

faq.question: Is fault finding included in a repair price?
faq.answer: Investigation and repair can be different stages. Ask what assessment is included, how an unresolved or intermittent fault would be handled, and which repair or replacement work needs separate approval. The written quote should make those boundaries clear.

faq.question: Should I request a switchboard upgrade when power keeps tripping?
faq.answer: A recurring trip does not establish that an upgrade is needed. Request an assessment of the affected installation first. Replacement or additional circuit work should follow the findings and an agreed scope, not the symptom alone.

faq.question: Can I book an after-hours electrician online?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Call 0413 477 667 for urgent work; an online form does not reserve an appointment. For shock or network danger, use the official safety route first.

faq.question: What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry.

faq.question: What household electrical work requires a licensed electrician in WA?
faq.answer: Arrange fixed wiring and power-point work through appropriately licensed electrical professionals and verify the relevant current documentation. Read the explanation.

emergency-electrician-perth.html.description: 24-hour emergency electrician in Perth for urgent private faults. Safety and utility routing first; call to confirm attendance and quoted repair charges.

headings.text: Common situations and what to report
Partial power loss while neighbours still have supply
A safety switch trips at night or an outlet smells burnt
Assessment, work plan and written quote

faq.question: Is an emergency electrician available after hours?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide 24-hour emergency electrical repairs. Call 0413 477 667 with the address and condition to confirm arrangements and charges. For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency or utility contact first.

faq.question: When should I call Western Power instead of a private electrician?
faq.answer: Shock or tingling, fallen or damaged network equipment and network emergencies need Western Power on 13 13 51. Call 000 for life-threatening danger or fire. Report supply interruptions through Western Power before assuming a private installation fault.

faq.question: What information helps an electrician prepare for a power fault?
faq.answer: State the address, affected lights or outlets, when it began, any visible warning signs and whether a supply interruption is reported. Do not remove covers or approach damaged equipment to gather details.

faq.question: How are emergency electrical repairs charged?
faq.answer: Charges follow the quoted work plan, including agreed attendance, investigation and repair inclusions. An unresolved or intermittent fault may need further investigation, which must be discussed rather than assumed to be included without limit.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is an emergency electrician available after hours?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. We provide 24-hour emergency electrical repairs. Call 0413 477 667 with the address and condition to confirm arrangements and charges. For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency or utility contact first."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "When should I call Western Power instead of a private electrician?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Shock or tingling, fallen or damaged network equipment and network emergencies need Western Power on 13 13 51. Call 000 for life-threatening danger or fire. Report supply interruptions through Western Power before assuming a private installation fault."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What information helps an electrician prepare for a power fault?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "State the address, affected lights or outlets, when it began, any visible warning signs and whether a supply interruption is reported. Do not remove covers or approach damaged equipment to gather details."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How are emergency electrical repairs charged?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Charges follow the quoted work plan, including agreed attendance, investigation and repair inclusions. An unresolved or intermittent fault may need further investigation, which must be discussed rather than assumed to be included without limit."
          }
        }

emergency-plumber-perth.html.description: 24-hour emergency plumber in Perth for urgent private plumbing repairs. Call to confirm attendance arrangements, the repair plan and emergency charges.

headings.text: Common situations and what to report
A burst pipe and water spreading through the kitchen
The only toilet is blocked or several drains back up
Assessment, work plan and written quote

faq.question: Is an after-hours plumber available in Perth tonight?
faq.answer: We provide 24-hour emergency plumbing repairs. Call 0413 477 667 to explain the condition and address and confirm attendance arrangements and charges. Availability is not a guaranteed arrival time.

faq.question: What counts as a plumbing emergency?
faq.answer: Active flooding, wastewater overflow or loss of an essential facility can need urgent attention. Describe the situation when calling; danger or a utility fault may need emergency services or Water Corporation before private repair.

faq.question: Are emergency plumbing repairs charged differently?
faq.answer: Emergency work is charged according to the quoted repair plan. Confirm attendance, investigation, materials and repair inclusions when arranging the work; standard-hours published guide ranges are not a fixed emergency quote.

faq.question: What if neighbours also have no water?
faq.answer: Check Water Corporation supply notices and report the interruption through its official channel. A wider outage should not be assumed to require a paid repair to private plumbing at your property.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is an after-hours plumber available in Perth tonight?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "We provide 24-hour emergency plumbing repairs. Call 0413 477 667 to explain the condition and address and confirm attendance arrangements and charges. Availability is not a guaranteed arrival time."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What counts as a plumbing emergency?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Active flooding, wastewater overflow or loss of an essential facility can need urgent attention. Describe the situation when calling; danger or a utility fault may need emergency services or Water Corporation before private repair."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Are emergency plumbing repairs charged differently?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Emergency work is charged according to the quoted repair plan. Confirm attendance, investigation, materials and repair inclusions when arranging the work; standard-hours published guide ranges are not a fixed emergency quote."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What if neighbours also have no water?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Check Water Corporation supply notices and report the interruption through its official channel. A wider outage should not be assumed to require a paid repair to private plumbing at your property."
          }
        }

faq.question: Can poor bathroom ventilation be caused by something other than the fan motor?
faq.answer: Yes. The path for exhausted air, restrictions and room air supply can affect performance. Assessment should distinguish the electrical or fan fault from ventilation or building work.

faq.question: Who can replace a noisy bathroom exhaust fan in Perth?
faq.answer: Our team accepts exhaust fan repair and replacement work. We assess the existing installation and quote for the appropriate fan and electrical scope, identifying additional ventilation work separately.

faq.question: Will a new fan solve every steam or mould problem?
faq.answer: No. Moisture sources and ventilation conditions also matter. A fan replacement addresses the agreed equipment work and is not a guarantee about all condensation or mould in the room.

faq.question: Does the quote include new ducting or roof work?
faq.answer: Only if expressly included. Tell us about the current installation and access so the quote can identify the fan, electrical work and any separately required duct or building work.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can poor bathroom ventilation be caused by something other than the fan motor?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. The path for exhausted air, restrictions and room air supply can affect performance. Assessment should distinguish the electrical or fan fault from ventilation or building work."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Who can replace a noisy bathroom exhaust fan in Perth?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Our team accepts exhaust fan repair and replacement work. We assess the existing installation and quote for the appropriate fan and electrical scope, identifying additional ventilation work separately."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Will a new fan solve every steam or mould problem?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. Moisture sources and ventilation conditions also matter. A fan replacement addresses the agreed equipment work and is not a guarantee about all condensation or mould in the room."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Does the quote include new ducting or roof work?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Only if expressly included. Tell us about the current installation and access so the quote can identify the fan, electrical work and any separately required duct or building work."
          }
        }

faq.html.title: Plumbing & Electrical Repair FAQs Perth | Ellis
faq.html.description: Answers about Perth plumbing and electrical bookings, quote inclusions, access, property-manager approval and when to use emergency or utility services.

headings.text: Perth plumbing and electrical repair FAQs
Find the price guide for the actual task

faq.question: Why can an online guide price differ from the written quote?
faq.answer: A guide range describes a standard scope; the property may need different access, materials, investigation or additional work. Ask the team to identify the inclusions and approval boundaries in the written quote rather than treating an online range as a fixed offer.

faq.question: Can I approve investigation without approving every possible repair?
faq.answer: Discuss the initial assessment scope and the person authorised to approve it. If further repair or replacement is proposed, ask what needs separate agreement. An enquiry or access arrangement alone is not approval of unlimited work.

faq.question: What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry.

faq.question: Can a hidden water leak cause a high bill without visible water damage?
faq.answer: Yes, a concealed leak is possible without visible damage. A bill increase alone is insufficient to diagnose one. Read the explanation.

faq.question: What is the difference between an RCD and a circuit breaker?
faq.answer: An RCD detects leakage imbalance; a circuit breaker responds to overload or short circuit. A combined device can do both. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Why has my hot water suddenly stopped working?
faq.answer: Several supply, heating or plumbing faults can interrupt hot water. The system type and affected outlets guide assessment. Read the explanation.

faq.question: What is the difference between a running toilet and a leaking toilet base?
faq.answer: A running cistern passes or replenishes water internally; a base leak is external water with a source that needs checking. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Who should a tenant contact first about plumbing or electrical repairs?
faq.answer: For routine repairs, report to the agent or landlord. For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency channel first. Read the explanation.

faq.question: What is Ellis Services Group?
faq.answer: Ellis Services Group is part of the Ellis Group, with a dedicated Perth repair team providing plumbing and electrical repairs and maintenance across Perth for homes, rentals, strata properties and commercial premises.

faq.question: Which areas does Ellis Services Group cover?
faq.answer: Our dedicated Perth repair team provides plumbing and electrical services across Perth. Include the property suburb and service required so we can prepare for the work.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the property address, affected area, factual description, when it began, whether it is active or worsening, and the best access contact. Property managers should include a work-order reference and approval pathway.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach exposed wiring, active sparking, wet electrical equipment or another hazard to take a photo.

faq.question: What if I do not know whether the problem is plumbing or electrical?
faq.answer: Describe what you observe rather than guessing. Our Perth team will identify the appropriate plumbing or electrical service path.

faq.question: Should I use the blocked drain or blocked toilet page?
faq.answer: Use Blocked Drains & Toilets for slow drainage, gurgling, backups or a blocked toilet. Use Toilet Repairs when the concern is specifically a running, leaking, slow-filling or non-functioning toilet.

faq.question: What should I do if a pipe bursts?
faq.answer: Put people and electrical safety first. If it is safe and familiar, isolate the water supply; otherwise keep clear and use the Burst Pipe Repair page to share the affected area and active water details.

faq.question: What should I do if a safety switch keeps tripping?
faq.answer: Do not repeatedly reset it. Note which areas lost power and what equipment was being used. Do not open the switchboard or work on fixed wiring.

faq.question: When is Ellis Services Group available?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed.

faq.question: Are licence details available?
faq.answer: Services are provided by appropriately licensed plumbing and electrical tradespeople. Current licence details are available on request for procurement or property management.

faq.question: When should I call 000?
faq.answer: Call 000 for life-threatening emergencies, fire, smoke, active arcing or immediate danger. Move to a safe location first. Once the immediate hazard is made safe, contact Ellis Services Group to arrange the repair assessment.

faq.question: Does appliance connection include repairing the appliance itself?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Plumbing connections, fixed electrical work and an internal appliance fault are different scopes. Describe the problem or proposed installation so the relevant work can be confirmed before booking.

faq.question: Can a supplied appliance be connected without changing pipework or wiring?
faq.answer: That depends on its specifications, location and existing services. Ask the quote to separate the connection from any required pipe, cable, circuit or access work.

faq.question: Is dishwasher installation the same as repairing a faulty dishwasher?
faq.answer: No. A connection request concerns the water, drainage and any agreed electrical arrangements. An internal appliance fault is a separate service. Describe the model, intended location and task so the accepted scope can be confirmed.

faq.question: Can I buy a replacement toilet before checking the connections?
faq.answer: Discuss the proposed product first. Dimensions, the existing connection position and access can affect installation. Confirm product supply, removal and any separate connection or restoration work before treating a product price as the full installed cost.

faq.question: Why does the laundry drain overflow when the washing machine empties?
faq.answer: A waste-connection restriction or drainage problem is possible; appliance faults require a separate scope. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Can you replace leaking washing machine taps?
faq.answer: Yes. Repair or replacement of the water supply tap can be assessed separately from internal washing-machine repairs. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need detailed installation specifications before contacting you?
faq.answer: No. Tell us the fixture, equipment or upgrade you need and your Perth suburb. We assess the site and connections, confirm the requirements and qualified work arrangements and provide the written quote. Additional access is agreed with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: What information helps with a fixture or appliance connection enquiry?
faq.answer: Include the fixture or appliance, the room, the issue you have noticed, the property address and whether water, drainage or electrical supply is involved.

faq.question: Can plumbing and electrical work be considered together?
faq.answer: Yes. Explain the complete requirement so the relevant plumbing and electrical work can be considered as part of the scope.

faq.question: How is the work priced?
faq.answer: Pricing is based on the agreed scope, property access, materials or parts required and the condition confirmed through the enquiry or assessment process.

faq.question: Does appliance connection include appliance servicing?
faq.answer: Connection work and repair of the appliance itself are different services. We identify the installation and connection tasks in the written quote and explain the boundary if the request involves an internal appliance fault.

faq.question: Can I buy a new hot-water unit before the assessment?
faq.answer: You can ask about a proposed product, but do not assume it suits the existing supply, connections or installation location. Confirm equipment compatibility, required trades and the full installation scope before purchase or approval.

faq.question: Are gas and heat-pump systems automatically included?
faq.answer: No. Give the system type and proposed task. Any gas, refrigeration or other specialist component must be checked against the appropriate service capability and authorisation before work is accepted.

faq.question: Why has my hot water suddenly stopped working?
faq.answer: Several supply, heating or plumbing faults can interrupt hot water. The system type and affected outlets guide assessment. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Why is there hot water at some taps but not at the shower?
faq.answer: A shower-only temperature problem can involve its fitting or mixing arrangement rather than failure of the whole heater. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Why might an electric hot water system trip a safety switch?
faq.answer: A heater or its electrical supply may be faulty. Do not bypass the safety switch or keep resetting it. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?
faq.answer: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: Is a hot-water problem plumbing or electrical?
faq.answer: It can be either, depending on the system and symptom. Describe the issue rather than trying to diagnose it yourself.

faq.question: What should I send with a hot-water enquiry?
faq.answer: Include the property address, unit location, what changed, affected fixtures and any safely readable unit information.

faq.question: Can I remove the cover to check the unit?
faq.answer: No. Do not remove covers or handle wiring.

faq.question: Can you assess repair and replacement options at the same visit?
faq.answer: We assess the existing system and explain the repair scope. If replacement needs to be considered, we discuss equipment and connection requirements as a separate option in the written quote. No replacement is assumed from the initial enquiry.

insights-hot-water-plumbing-or-electrica.description: No hot water in Perth? Understand outlet versus system faults, plumbing and electrical assessment, and repair versus replacement scope before booking Ellis.

headings.text: Is a hot-water problem plumbing or electrical?

faq.question: Who should I call if I do not know which trade is needed?
faq.answer: Describe the system, affected outlets and current symptoms to the team. The appropriate trade and assessment scope need to be confirmed; you do not need to remove covers or test equipment to choose a category.

faq.question: Does hot water at one tap rule out a plumbing problem elsewhere?
faq.answer: No. A difference between outlets is useful context but does not establish the faulty component. Report which outlets are affected so the investigation can be scoped.

faq.question: Should I treat water at the meter as a normal private-pipe repair?
faq.answer: Not automatically. Follow Water Corporation guidance for the meter and explain where the water appears from a safe position. The supply or meter boundary matters; do not assume every leak belongs to privately maintained plumbing.

faq.question: Should I open a wall before the plumber visits?
faq.answer: No. Explain the visible location and current condition. Investigation, access and restoration should be agreed as parts of the scope; opening finishes yourself may introduce a hazard without establishing the source.

insights-safety-switch-keeps-tripping.ht.title: Safety Switch Keeps Tripping? What to Note | Perth
insights-safety-switch-keeps-tripping.ht.description: A safety switch keeps tripping? Know what to report safely, how RCD and breaker concerns differ, and what a Perth electrical fault assessment and quote cover.

headings.text: What to do when a safety switch keeps tripping
A safety switch and a circuit breaker are not the same device
What an electrical assessment needs to establish
Agree the investigation and repair scope
Report a symptom without trying to reproduce it

faq.question: Should I keep resetting the switch to identify the faulty appliance?
faq.answer: No. A recurring trip needs an appropriate electrical assessment. Record what you already observed without repeatedly reproducing the fault, opening equipment or bypassing protection.

faq.question: Is a tripping safety switch always a problem with the switch itself?
faq.answer: No. The affected installation, connected equipment and protective device may need assessment. A trip alone is not evidence that replacing the switch will resolve the cause.

lighting-installation-perth.html.description: Lighting installation and repairs in Perth. Assess flickering LED downlights, fitting replacement and new lighting positions, with an agreed written quote.

headings.text: Common situations and what to report

faq.question: Why do LED lights flicker when connected to a dimmer?
faq.answer: The lamp, driver and dimmer may not be compatible, but a connection or supply problem can also cause flickering. An electrician assesses the installation before deciding which part needs attention. Do not remove a fitting to investigate.

faq.question: Can you repair flickering LED downlights in Perth?
faq.answer: Yes. We assess the affected lighting and quote for the agreed repair or replacement. Tell us whether one light, a room or several circuits are affected, and whether the dimmer or a large appliance changes the symptom.

faq.question: Should I buy replacement fittings first?
faq.answer: Discuss the product first. Dimensions, controls, driver requirements and ceiling access can affect suitability. The quote confirms who supplies the fitting and which installation work is included.

faq.question: Does replacing a light include new wiring?
faq.answer: Only wiring included in the agreed scope. A like-for-like fitting replacement and a new lighting location may require different work; the existing installation must be checked before the scope is settled.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Why do LED lights flicker when connected to a dimmer?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "The lamp, driver and dimmer may not be compatible, but a connection or supply problem can also cause flickering. An electrician assesses the installation before deciding which part needs attention. Do not remove a fitting to investigate."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can you repair flickering LED downlights in Perth?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. We assess the affected lighting and quote for the agreed repair or replacement. Tell us whether one light, a room or several circuits are affected, and whether the dimmer or a large appliance changes the symptom."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Should I buy replacement fittings first?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Discuss the product first. Dimensions, controls, driver requirements and ceiling access can affect suitability. The quote confirms who supplies the fitting and which installation work is included."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Does replacing a light include new wiring?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Only wiring included in the agreed scope. A like-for-like fitting replacement and a new lighting location may require different work; the existing installation must be checked before the scope is settled."
          }
        }
      ]

news-clearer-property-maintenance-enquir.description: Prepare a clear Perth plumbing or electrical enquiry: property location, current symptoms, access and approval details, without needing a diagnosis or photos.

headings.text: A clearer way to send a property maintenance enquiry
Choose a service starting point without diagnosing the fault
State the current condition and property location
From first contact to an agreed visit and quote
A useful first message can be brief

faq.question: Can I send an enquiry before I have all the equipment details?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with the address, current symptom and contact. Say which details are not yet available. Do not dismantle equipment or delay appropriate emergency action to complete a checklist.

faq.question: Should the first message name the part I want replaced?
faq.answer: Only if it is a planned installation or an existing confirmed instruction. For an unexplained fault, describe the observation so the assessment is not limited by an unsupported diagnosis.

news-keeping-access-information-together.description: Keep repair access details, occupant contacts and changed arrangements with the work request. Practical privacy-aware preparation for Perth maintenance visits.

headings.text: Keeping access information with the repair request
Confirm entry to the property and to the equipment
Use a named contact and update changed arrangements
Protect private information while arranging the repair
Confirm access to the equipment as well as the property

faq.question: What if the occupant cannot attend the agreed visit?
faq.answer: Contact the team to update access arrangements rather than assuming the original instruction remains workable. Confirm who will provide entry and whether access to the actual equipment is available.

faq.question: Should I put alarm codes or keys in the enquiry form?
faq.answer: Do not include unnecessary sensitive entry information in a general enquiry. Confirm with the team how any required private access details will be shared for the agreed visit.

news-useful-property-work-order.html.title: Plumbing & Electrical Work Order Checklist | Ellis Perth
news-useful-property-work-order.html.description: A practical repair work-order checklist: assessable tasks, property references, access and approval limits for Perth property managers and owners.

headings.text: What makes a useful plumbing or electrical work order
Describe an assessable task, not an assumed repair
Close the work order with the actual outcome
Separate assessment authority from repair authority

faq.question: Is a spending limit enough to define a work order?
faq.answer: No. State the requested assessment or work, the property, any exclusions and who can approve changes. A limit alone does not explain which task is authorised.

faq.question: What should happen if the assessment changes the proposed repair?
faq.answer: Record the finding and revised scope against the same work-order reference. Follow the nominated approval pathway before assuming that the original instruction covers additional or different work.

Close the record with what was actually completed and any follow-up recommendations; an inspection or recommendation is not a completed repair.

faq.question: What access details help with a CBD apartment visit?
faq.answer: Include the unit and building reference, nominated on-site contact and any agreed concierge, lift or parking arrangements. Keep private access codes out of public messages and confirm how they will be shared with the team.

faq.question: What should a CBD or Inner Perth repair request include?
faq.answer: Include the property address, building or unit details, access requirements, observed issue and whether the repair is plumbing or electrical.

faq.question: Can a property manager request plumbing and electrical repairs together?
faq.answer: Yes. List each issue separately, then include the access contact and approval pathway for the property.

plumbing.html.description: Book a Perth plumber for drains, leaks, hot water, taps, toilets and fixture connections. Our local team assesses the work and provides a written quote.

headings.text: Start with the symptom, not a guess.

faq.question: What does a plumbing quote include?
faq.answer: The written quote identifies the agreed investigation or repair, included materials and relevant access work. The published AUD ranges are guides for standard-hours, standard-scope work, not a fixed quote for an unseen property. Ask which additional work would require further approval.

faq.question: Can you assess a shower leak or low water pressure?
faq.answer: Describe whether the leak appears during use and which outlets have changed. The assessment separates a plumbing fault from other causes, such as waterproofing or a supply issue. Specialist or additional work is confirmed separately, not assumed from a symptom.

faq.question: Can you attend immediately or outside standard hours?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency fees follow the quoted work plan. Utility faults and immediate danger use the appropriate official channel first.

faq.question: What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?
faq.answer: Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry.

faq.question: What jobs should I call a licensed plumber for?
faq.answer: Use appropriately authorised plumbing trades for regulated fixed-water and drainage work; confirm the specific task and documentation. Read the explanation.

          "name": "What does a plumbing quote include?",

            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "The written quote identifies the agreed investigation or repair, included materials and relevant access work. The published AUD ranges are guides for standard-hours, standard-scope work, not a fixed quote for an unseen property. Ask which additional work would require further approval."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can you assess a shower leak or low water pressure?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Describe whether the leak appears during use and which outlets have changed. The assessment separates a plumbing fault from other causes, such as waterproofing or a supply issue. Specialist or additional work is confirmed separately, not assumed from a symptom."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can you attend immediately or outside standard hours?",

            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency fees follow the quoted work plan. Utility faults and immediate danger use the appropriate official channel first."
          }
        },

          "name": "What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?",

No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry."
          }

power-faults-perth.html.description: Electrical fault finding and power repairs in Perth for outages, circuit faults and recurring trips. Book a licensed electrician assessment and written quote.

Electrical fault-finding services for Perth properties
Loss of power in a room or part of the property
From electrical investigation to an agreed repair
Repair scope, access and additional circuit work
Electrical fault finding: what the investigation needs to establish
Electrical fault finding Perth: symptoms and service choices

faq.question: What if the power fault is not present during the visit?
faq.answer: Give the electrician the timing and affected areas so the assessment can be scoped. An intermittent symptom may not be resolved in a single visit. Ask what investigation is included and what further testing or access would require approval.

faq.question: Does fault finding include replacing the faulty equipment?
faq.answer: Investigation identifies the proposed next step; repair or replacement may be a separate task. The quote should state the included assessment and any additional work before you approve it.

faq.question: Why does only one part of a house lose power?
faq.answer: A fault can affect one circuit or connection while other rooms still have power. Working lights do not establish outlet safety. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Can you investigate an intermittent power fault?
faq.answer: Yes. An intermittent fault can be investigated, although its timing may require more than one assessment stage. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?
faq.answer: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: What information helps with a power-fault enquiry?
faq.answer: List the affected rooms or circuits, what happened first, what was in use and any warning signs you can observe safely.

faq.question: Should I keep resetting a tripping circuit?
faq.answer: No. Avoid repeatedly resetting an electrical device that trips again.

faq.question: What if I smell burning or see smoke?
faq.answer: Move to safety and call 000 if there is immediate danger.

faq.question: Is fault finding included in the same scope as the repair?
faq.answer: Investigation and repair can involve separate tasks. We explain the assessment scope and the proposed corrective work, including components or circuit changes, before the written quote is agreed.

power-points-perth.html.description: Power point installation, replacement and repairs in Perth. Assess failed outlets, damaged switches and new locations, with a written quote.

headings.text: Power point installation Perth: service scope
Common situations and what to report
Power points not working but lights still work
Assessment, work plan and written quote
Power Point Installation & Repairs Perth FAQs

faq.question: Why can a power point stop working while other outlets still work?
faq.answer: Outlets may be on different circuits, or the fault may affect a connection or one part of a circuit. The pattern helps the investigation but does not establish the cause. Do not remove the outlet cover or repeatedly reset protection.

faq.question: Is a warm or discoloured power point a safety concern?
faq.answer: Yes. Stop using it and keep clear of visible damage, smoke or sparking. For a life-threatening emergency or fire call 000; for shock or tingling contact Western Power on 13 13 51. Arrange electrical assessment rather than continuing to use the outlet.

faq.question: How much does it cost to add a double power point?
faq.answer: The quote depends on the outlet, location, circuit requirements and access. We confirm parts and electrical work in writing; there is no universal amount that includes every possible circuit change.

faq.question: Can an electrician replace a damaged power point?
faq.answer: Yes. We assess the damaged point and any related fault before quoting the replacement work. Share the location and observable condition, but do not touch or dismantle damaged equipment.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Why can a power point stop working while other outlets still work?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Outlets may be on different circuits, or the fault may affect a connection or one part of a circuit. The pattern helps the investigation but does not establish the cause. Do not remove the outlet cover or repeatedly reset protection."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is a warm or discoloured power point a safety concern?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. Stop using it and keep clear of visible damage, smoke or sparking. For a life-threatening emergency or fire call 000; for shock or tingling contact Western Power on 13 13 51. Arrange electrical assessment rather than continuing to use the outlet."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How much does it cost to add a double power point?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "The quote depends on the outlet, location, circuit requirements and access. We confirm parts and electrical work in writing; there is no universal amount that includes every possible circuit change."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can an electrician replace a damaged power point?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes. We assess the damaged point and any related fault before quoting the replacement work. Share the location and observable condition, but do not touch or dismantle damaged equipment."
          }
        }
      ]

property-management.html.title: Property Manager Plumbing & Electrical Perth | Ellis
property-management.html.description: Plumbing and electrical maintenance for Perth property managers, rentals and strata. Coordinate access, work orders, approval and an on-site written quote.

headings.text: Plumbing and Electrical Maintenance for Perth Property Managers
Request Plumbing and Electrical Repairs for a Managed Property
Rental and Strata Maintenance: Scope, Access and Approval
Plumbing and Electrical Work Orders: Property, Fault and Approval
Tenant Repair Reports and Property-Manager Approval
A clear plumbing or electrical work order
Plumbing and Electrical Maintenance in Perth: Work-Order Questions

faq.question: Can an occupant approve extra repairs during the visit?
faq.answer: Access permission and authority to approve cost are different. Give the team the nominated decision-maker, agreed limit and escalation contact. If additional work is needed, its approval follows that instruction rather than assuming the person on site can approve it.

faq.question: Can one request cover a plumbing and an electrical problem?
faq.answer: Yes. Describe each symptom and location separately and include the same property reference. The team confirms which trades and tasks are required. Coordination does not guarantee one diagnosis, one contractor approval or completion in a single visit.

faq.question: What information should a strata work order include?
faq.answer: State the affected lot or common area, the managing contact, access arrangements and who can approve the proposed scope. Do not decide responsibility from the location alone; shared infrastructure and approval requirements need to be clarified for that property.

faq.question: Can I request completion notes or an agency invoice reference?
faq.answer: Include the required records and agency reference when arranging the visit. Agree what documentation will be provided for the defined work. A reference or maintenance receipt does not by itself certify parts of the property outside that scope.

faq.question: Who should a tenant contact first about plumbing or electrical repairs?
faq.answer: For routine repairs, report to the agent or landlord. For immediate danger, use the appropriate emergency channel first. Read the explanation.

faq.question: What is the difference between an RCD and a circuit breaker?
faq.answer: An RCD detects an imbalance associated with current leaking from the intended path. A circuit breaker protects against overload or short circuit. A combined device can provide both functions; the devices are not interchangeable terms.

faq.question: Does a tripping safety switch mean the switch itself is faulty?
faq.answer: No. A trip may indicate a fault in a circuit or connected equipment. The device and installation need assessment before deciding whether the switch, wiring or other equipment requires repair.

faq.question: Can smoke alarms and RCDs be checked during one visit?
faq.answer: Yes, both can be arranged within an agreed visit. State the checks and records required so the scope, access, interruptions and price are confirmed together.

faq.question: Is an RCD test the same as a whole-property safety certificate?
faq.answer: No. The record relates to the agreed devices and checks. Confirm the required documentation and any broader inspection separately rather than assuming an RCD test certifies the entire property.

      "mainEntity": [
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What is the difference between an RCD and a circuit breaker?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "An RCD detects an imbalance associated with current leaking from the intended path. A circuit breaker protects against overload or short circuit. A combined device can provide both functions; the devices are not interchangeable terms."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Does a tripping safety switch mean the switch itself is faulty?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. A trip may indicate a fault in a circuit or connected equipment. The device and installation need assessment before deciding whether the switch, wiring or other equipment requires repair."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Can smoke alarms and RCDs be checked during one visit?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Yes, both can be arranged within an agreed visit. State the checks and records required so the scope, access, interruptions and price are confirmed together."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Is an RCD test the same as a whole-property safety certificate?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "No. The record relates to the agreed devices and checks. Confirm the required documentation and any broader inspection separately rather than assuming an RCD test certifies the entire property."
          }
        }
      ]

faq.question: Can you work with every smart-home brand or protocol?
faq.answer: No universal compatibility is assumed. Give the product details and existing system so the proposed configuration and electrical scope can be assessed before acceptance.

faq.question: Does this page confirm solar, battery or EV-charger installation?
faq.answer: No. Those products can require specialist capability and a separate agreed scope. Ask about the specific equipment and work; this general enquiry is not confirmation that every energy system can be installed or repaired.

faq.question: Do I need detailed installation specifications before contacting you?
faq.answer: No. Tell us the fixture, equipment or upgrade you need and your Perth suburb. We assess the site and connections, confirm the requirements and qualified work arrangements and provide the written quote. Additional access is agreed with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: What should I include in a smart-home electrical enquiry?
faq.answer: Include the property address, the equipment or control you are considering, the rooms affected and the outcome you want to achieve.

faq.question: Can existing energy equipment be assessed?
faq.answer: Describe the equipment and the behaviour you have noticed. Leave covers and electrical connections in place until the work can be assessed safely.

faq.question: How is smart-home or energy electrical work priced?
faq.answer: Pricing is based on the agreed electrical scope, equipment requirements, property access, materials and any circuit work confirmed through the enquiry or assessment process.

faq.question: Can you confirm compatibility before I approve the work?
faq.answer: Compatibility forms part of the installation assessment. We review the selected equipment and existing setup, then identify the proposed functions and electrical tasks in the written scope rather than promising universal integration.

faq.question: Is a safety switch the same as a circuit breaker?
faq.answer: No. The devices have different protective functions. If you are unsure which has operated, report the affected rooms and any safely visible label. The electrician identifies the device and assessment needed.

faq.question: Can replacing the RCD guarantee that tripping will stop?
faq.answer: No. Tripping can be associated with another part of the installation or connected equipment. The cause needs assessment; replacing the protective device without that assessment may not resolve the fault.

faq.question: What is the difference between an RCD and a circuit breaker?
faq.answer: An RCD detects leakage imbalance; a circuit breaker responds to overload or short circuit. A combined device can do both. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Does a tripping safety switch mean the switch itself is faulty?
faq.answer: No. Tripping can originate in connected equipment or wiring, so replacing the switch alone may not resolve it. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?
faq.answer: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: Why does a safety switch trip?
faq.answer: There can be several causes. The most useful first step is to record what was happening and avoid trying to diagnose fixed wiring yourself.

faq.question: Can I open the switchboard?
faq.answer: No. Do not open switchboards or remove covers.

faq.question: What should I tell Ellis Services Group?
faq.answer: Include the affected areas, when it happened, what was in use and any safely observable warning signs.

faq.question: Will replacing the safety switch stop the tripping?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Tripping can relate to more than the device itself. We investigate the relevant fault and explain whether device replacement or another identified repair is appropriate before quoting.

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Tripping can originate in connected equipment or wiring, so replacing the switch alone may not resolve it. Read the explanation.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

mainEntity.name: Can I send photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

mainEntity.name: Why does a safety switch trip?

acceptedAnswer.text: There can be several causes. The most useful first step is to record what was happening and avoid trying to diagnose fixed wiring yourself.

mainEntity.name: Can I open the switchboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Do not open switchboards or remove covers.

mainEntity.name: What should I tell Ellis Services Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Include the affected areas, when it happened, what was in use and any safely observable warning signs.

mainEntity.name: Will replacing the safety switch stop the tripping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Tripping can relate to more than the device itself. We investigate the relevant fault and explain whether device replacement or another identified repair is appropriate before quoting.

shower-plumbing-repairs-perth.html.description: Shower plumbing leak repairs in Perth. Assess fittings and supply or waste pipes; separate plumbing repairs from waterproofing and building work.

headings.text: Shower leak repairs Perth: service scope
Common situations and what to report
A damp ceiling after an upstairs shower
A damp wall with no visible tap leak
Assessment, work plan and written quote
Shower Plumbing Leak Repairs Perth FAQs

faq.question: How can a plumbing leak be distinguished from failed shower waterproofing?
faq.answer: The source needs investigation. Supply and waste pipe tests, the pattern of water during use and access findings can help separate causes. Dampness alone cannot confirm a failed membrane or a leaking pipe.

faq.question: Do I need a plumber or a waterproofing specialist for a leaking shower?
faq.answer: Start by describing the symptoms. We assess the plumbing and explain if the findings point to waterproofing or other building work outside the agreed plumbing scope. These are different repairs and should not be assumed to share one quote.

faq.question: Can you guarantee the shower can be repaired without removing tiles?
faq.answer: No. Access depends on the fault and the installation. We explain the proposed access and the repair scope before work proceeds, including who handles any affected finishes.

faq.question: What should I send before a shower leak visit?
faq.answer: Provide the suburb, where water appears, when it happens and the affected room below or beside the shower. Safely taken photos are optional; do not enter a wet electrical area or open walls to gather evidence.

faq.question: Can alarm and safety-switch work be discussed in the same request?
faq.answer: Yes. List the alarm locations and the separate safety-switch concern or requested check. Confirm the assessment, included tests and reporting requirements; one task does not automatically include the other.

faq.question: Does replacing one smoke alarm certify the whole property?
faq.answer: No. A single-unit replacement and a defined whole-property assessment are different scopes. State the property context and any required documentation before agreeing the work.

faq.question: Can I request a new alarm location as well as replacement of a faulty unit?
faq.answer: Yes, include both proposed tasks in the enquiry. The team needs to confirm the requirements and accepted scope for the new location separately. Replacement of an existing unit does not automatically include a changed supply, interconnection or additional locations.

faq.question: Why can a hardwired smoke alarm keep chirping?
faq.answer: Chirping can indicate a device or backup-power warning. Follow the model instructions and arrange assessment without removing hardwired equipment. Read the explanation.

faq.question: What smoke alarm requirements apply to rental homes in WA?
faq.answer: WA rental homes require working, compliant mains-powered alarms under the applicable rules and exceptions, with units less than ten years old. Read the explanation.

faq.question: Do I need to diagnose the problem first?
faq.answer: No. Describe the observable change and property context. We inspect the affected area on site to establish the cause and confirm the repair scope. If more access is needed, we agree it with you first.

faq.question: Can I send photos?
faq.answer: Photos are optional: email safely taken photos to maxinemaintenance.au@outlook.com. You can contact us without photos. Do not approach a hazard, remove covers or dismantle equipment to take a photo.

faq.question: Can you help with a smoke alarm that keeps beeping?
faq.answer: Yes. Tell us where it is, what it is doing and when the behaviour began.

faq.question: Should I remove a hardwired smoke alarm?
faq.answer: No. Do not remove a hardwired unit or handle its wiring.

faq.question: Can a property manager send a maintenance request?
faq.answer: Yes. Include the property address, occupant access and approval details.

faq.question: Does repairing one alarm assess the whole property?
faq.answer: No. The agreed scope identifies the units and work included. A broader property assessment or replacement plan is a separate request, which we discuss and define before quoting.

faq.question: When does an older switchboard need repair or replacement?
faq.answer: Condition, faults, the existing protection and proposed electrical work guide that decision. An older board needs professional assessment, not an automatic full-replacement claim based on age alone.

faq.question: Can I get an itemised quote before approving an upgrade?
faq.answer: Yes. The written scope identifies the proposed equipment and work, testing, any supply coordination and additional work requiring approval. Confirm inclusions before proceeding.

faq.question: How much does a switchboard upgrade cost in Perth?
faq.answer: Cost depends on the assessed installation, equipment, circuit work, access and supply arrangements. We quote for that scope; no single price is assumed to cover every board or property.

faq.question: Will a switchboard upgrade fix a circuit that keeps tripping?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The cause may lie in connected equipment or a circuit. Investigation should establish the fault before an upgrade is presented as the solution.
